```yaml
name: Issue Triage, Release Drafter, Discord Announce, and PR Review

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  claude-issue-triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run Claude Issue Triage
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
          prompt: |
            You are Claude, a helpful assistant. Please triage this issue according to our guidelines:
            - Bug report
            - Recipe idea
            - Schema idea
            - Other
            Check for duplicates, assess scope fit, suggest labels, and post a welcoming comment.
          settings: '{"model": "claude-2"}'

  claude-pr-review:
    needs: claude-issue-triage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run Claude PR Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
          prompt: |
            You are Claude, a helpful assistant. Please review this pull request according to our guidelines:
            - Design pattern check
            - Scope-fit check
            - Other
            Flag any issues that do not meet our standards.
          settings: '{"model": "claude-2"}'

  release-drafter:
    needs: claude-pr-review
    triggers:
      push:
        branches:
          - main
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run Release Drafter
        uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@v5
        with:
          config: .github/auto-label.yml
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  discord-announce:
    needs: release-drafter
    triggers:
      release:
        types: [published]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Post to Discord
        uses: third-party-actions/discord-webhook-action@v1
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          message: |
            A new release has been published!
            <https://github.com/NateBJones-Projects/OB1/releases/latest>
```
